technical_name: DNS resolution failed while IP connectivity works

remediation.label: refresh the list of website addresses Windows has remembered
remediation.user_impact: This clears a cache of website names. It does not delete files or change your Wi-Fi password.

plain_language.problem: Your computer is connected to the network, but it cannot translate website names into the addresses it needs to reach them.
plain_language.solution: I can refresh that name list. If it still fails, the router or internet provider may be the next place to look.
